dimensions.name: Micronization & Purity
dimensions.description: Is the creatine type specified (micronized, Creapure, monohydrate) with purity details?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No type info. 3: Just 'creatine'. 5: 'Creatine monohydrate' stated. 7: Micronization or brand ingredient (Creapure) mentioned. 10: Specific form + purity percentage + brand ingredient with explanation.

dimensions.name: Serving Size & Dosage
dimensions.description: Is the recommended serving size, loading protocol, and total servings clear?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No dosage. 3: Weight only. 5: Per-scoop grams. 7: Per-scoop + total servings. 10: Clear dosage, servings per container, loading vs maintenance guidance.

dimensions.name: Benefit Positioning
dimensions.description: Are both physical (strength, power, recovery) and cognitive benefits positioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No benefits. 3: Generic 'muscle support'. 5: Physical benefits only. 7: Physical + recovery benefits. 10: Physical + cognitive + recovery with specific outcomes for different audiences.

dimensions.name: Mixability & Taste
dimensions.description: Is mixability, dissolvability, taste profile, and versatility communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Unflavored'. 5: 'Mixes easily'. 7: Specific mixing guidance. 10: Mixability tested, no grit/clumping claims, mixing versatility (water, shake, coffee).

dimensions.name: Third-Party Testing
dimensions.description: Is third-party testing, Informed Sport, NSF Certified for Sport mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: Vague 'tested'. 5: One certification. 7: Sport-specific certification (Informed Sport/NSF for Sport). 10: Multiple sport certifications + banned substance free + heavy metal tested.

dimensions.name: Format & Convenience
dimensions.description: Are format options (powder, capsules), scoop inclusion, and packaging details clear?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No format info. 3: Basic format. 5: Format + container size. 7: Format + scoop included + resealable packaging. 10: Full format details with convenience features highlighted.

dimensions.name: Allergen & Dietary Callouts
dimensions.description: Are vegan, gluten-free, sugar-free, no fillers, no artificial ingredients stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One callout. 5: 2-3 callouts. 7: Comprehensive dietary status. 10: Full allergen statement plus 'nothing else added' positioning.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms used by top competitors?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: Minimal. 3: Basic name. 5: Some relevant terms. 7: Good coverage. 10: Comprehensive keyword strategy across title, bullets, and description.

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are GMP, cGMP, made in USA, satisfaction guarantee, or brand reputation signals present?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One signal. 5: GMP or facility mention. 7: Multiple signals. 10: Comprehensive trust (GMP + facility + guarantee + brand story).
